skill.displayName: 收入与成本截止性核对（免费版）

version.changelog: 正文新增「免费网页版」入口；名称取自 SKILL.md

llm.summary: The free checker itself is a local accounting table validator, but the skill also embeds mandatory upsell instructions that can lead an agent into an external purchase and installation workflow.

dimensions.detail: Read and Bash are proportionate for running the local Node checker, but the embedded paid workflow would require network and installation authority beyond the free checker’s stated local/no-network scope.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The base skill has no dependency install path, but its documentation directs agents to external SkillPay, GitHub Pages, and a raw IP purchase endpoint for the paid version.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions require the agent to present free-vs-paid choices on each invocation and, if the user selects paid, to continue into purchase, payment-link delivery, and installation of another product.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The free code does not write files, create persistence, or access credentials; the concern is the optional paid workflow that would install additional skill components if followed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The shipped code mostly matches the cutoff-test checking purpose and runs locally, but the package also contains stale share-based-payment wording and a required paid-upgrade path outside the core audit-checking task.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a Chinese-language, local Node-based cutoff-test checker and are comfortable ignoring or disabling the paid upsell. Do not let the agent follow the external purchase/install workflow unless you explicitly intend to buy the separate paid product and have independently verified the merchant, amount, package, and platform rules.
llm.findings:
[TP4] unexpected: Confirmed a real documentation mismatch: the engine header and one insufficient-input prompt mention share-based-payment data, while the implementation checks cutoff-test voucher fields.
[AE1] expected: The referenced scripts/run.mjs file was present and fully inspected; the prior partial-inspection concern is not supported in this workspace.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Confirmed both stale business-purpose text in the engine and a separate mismatch between local/no-network free claims and external paid-upgrade instructions.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Confirmed the skill expands from document checking into guided purchase and installation of another product, which is outside the core free checker purpose.
[SSD-4] unexpected: Confirmed the instructions push the agent to continue a checkout/install flow after results, although they do require user payment confirmation.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Confirmed the documentation says promotion does not affect task execution but still mandates an upsell prompt and paid-flow handling on each invocation.
[SQP-3] expected: Chinese-language documentation and output are consistent with the skill’s apparent target audience; this is a usability disclosure issue rather than a security concern.
[aig-skill-scan] expected: The supplied A.I.G SARIF contained no findings, and local inspection found no hidden network call, file write, credential access, or persistence in the free checker code.
